sources.title: Qarvexium/QED-B1-Instruction-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The underlying foundation model was pretrained using original model weights and an independently created dataset. QED-B1-Instruction-v2 further trains the QED-B1-Instruction-v2 on an original instruction-following dataset to improve its ability to understand prompts, follow instructions, answer questions, write text, generate code, and perform general assistant-style tasks.
